newsitem.title: GERMANY: Handelsblatt German leading indicator rises.
newsitem.headline: Handelsblatt German leading indicator rises.

text.p: The Handelsblatt daily said on Tuesday that its leading indicator for the German economy had risen slightly this month to reach the same level as January.
The newspaper said in an item from its Wednesday edition that its March indicator had risen by 1.6 percent after a fall of 1.5 percent last month.
The indicator stagnated overall for the last four months, but still stands one percentage point higher than its trough last summer and well above year-earlier levels.

"This points to a robust, but not very dynamic development in the coming months," the newspaper said, adding that the latest changes refuted the view recovery was stalling. -- Bonn newsroom, 49-228-26097150
